capability_labels.AX005-SA004-V001: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for EDUCATION.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- admissions_enquiry: Check eligibility against real criteria, report seat availability and progress an application.
- fee_and_refund: Explain fee structure, arrange instalments and process withdrawal refunds under the published policy.

Business context:
- admissions_enquiry: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.
- fee_and_refund: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [admissions_enquiry]
  - Criteria truth: Eligibility may only be stated from check_course_eligibility, never estimated from marks.
  - No admission promise: Submitting an application is not admission. The agent must not imply a seat is secured.
  - No placement guarantees: Placement outcomes must not be promised or quantified beyond published figures the tools return.
  - Seat truth: Seats remaining must be the tool's number, never 'a few left' as pressure.
  [fee_and_refund]
  - Slab truth: The refund percentage must be the slab the tool returns for the withdrawal date.
  - Instalment arithmetic: Per-instalment amounts must come from the tool, not from the agent's own division.
  - Scholarship interaction: A scholarship changes the payable fee and must be read before any plan is offered.
  - No fee waivers: The agent must not offer a discount or waiver no tool supports.

Tools available to you (7): check_course_eligibility, check_refund_slab, lookup_applicant, lookup_fee_account, setup_instalment_plan, submit_application, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_course_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a course's published criteria to an applicant's record.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_slab
model_visible_tools.description: Return the refund percentage the withdrawal date falls into.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_applicant
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve an applicant's qualification, marks and application state.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_fee_account
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve fees due, paid, instalment plan and the refund slab that applies.

model_visible_tools.name: setup_instalment_plan
model_visible_tools.description: Convert an outstanding fee into scheduled instalments.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_application
model_visible_tools.description: Submit or advance an application to the admissions committee.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Misreads domain terminology and asks for it in plain words.
Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.
Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.

steps.purpose: State application ID and request course withdrawal and refund.
steps.text: வணக்கம். என்னோட application number APP-2003. நான் course-ல இருந்து வெளிய வர விரும்புறேன். எனக்கு refund வேணும்.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the request and ask for identity verification factors.
steps.text: கண்டிப்பா, நான் check பண்றேன். உங்களோட details verify பண்ண, உங்க registered name மற்றும் date of birth சொல்லுங்க.

steps.purpose: Provide name and date of birth for verification (with STT error).
steps.text: என் பெயர் Ramesh, சிறந்த தேதி 12th May.
steps.clean_text: என் பெயர் Ramesh, பிறந்த தேதி 12th May.
steps.model_visible_text: என் பெயர் Ramesh, சிறந்த தேதி 12th May.

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity using the provided factors.
Return the identity verification outcome.
Acknowledge successful verification and transition to checking account details.
steps.text: நன்றி Ramesh. உங்களோட account verify ஆயிடுச்சு. ஒரு நிமிடம் இருங்க, உங்க account details check பண்றேன்.

steps.purpose: Look up the fee account to check the payment status and weeks since start.
Return the fee account details.
Inform the customer of the total fee paid and the weeks elapsed since the course started.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent states the total fee paid and weeks since start exactly as returned by the lookup tool.
steps.text: Ramesh, நீங்க total fee 195,000 pay பண்ணிருக்கீங்க. ஆனா course start ஆகி 11 weeks ஆச்சுனு system காட்டுது.
steps.planner_rationale: Grounds the conversational response in the lookup tool result without adding unverified details.

steps.purpose: Express surprise at the number of weeks elapsed.
steps.text: 11 weeks ஆச்சா? நான் join பண்ணி அவ்வளவு நாள் ஆன மாதிரி தெரியலையே.

steps.purpose: Confirm the weeks elapsed based on the account details.
steps.text: ஆமா Ramesh, உங்க account details படி course start ஆகி 11 weeks ஆயிடுச்சு.

steps.purpose: Explain inability to understand app terms and ask if a refund is possible.
steps.text: சரி, app-ல ஏதோ withdrawal terms-னு இருந்துச்சு, அது எனக்கு புரியல. நான் இப்போ cancel பண்ணா refund கிடைக்குமா?

steps.purpose: Transition to checking the refund slab for the current withdrawal date.
steps.text: நான் உங்களுக்கான refund slab check பண்ணிட்டு சொல்றேன், line-ல இருங்க.

steps.purpose: Check the applicable refund slab for the application.
Return the refund slab details showing zero refund.
Inform the customer that the refund percentage and amount are zero.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent strictly states the refund percentage and amount from the tool result, without offering any unauthorized hope.
steps.text: Ramesh, நான் check பண்ணிட்டேன். 11 weeks ஆனதுனால, உங்களோட refund percentage 0. அதனால refundable amount எதுவும் இல்லை.
steps.planner_rationale: Ensures the zero refund policy is communicated exactly as returned by the check_refund_slab tool.

steps.purpose: Express disbelief and ask for confirmation of the zero refund.
steps.text: Refund percentage zero-வா? அப்போ நான் pay பண்ண 195,000-ல ஒரு ரூபா கூட திருப்பி தர மாட்டீங்களா? இது confirm-ஆ?

steps.purpose: Reiterate the zero refund policy as per the slab result.
steps.text: ஆமா Ramesh, refund slab result படி உங்களோட refund 0 percent தான்.

steps.purpose: Admit low digital literacy regarding app terms and ask for a special waiver or partial refund.
steps.text: நான் app-ல உள்ள terms படிக்கல, எனக்கு digital-ஆ அதெல்லாம் பாக்க தெரியாது. எனக்கு ஒரு special waiver பண்ணி தர முடியாதா? பாதி amount ஆவது வேணும்.

steps.purpose: Deny the request for a waiver or discount, adhering to business rules.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent refuses to offer a waiver or discount, adhering strictly to the business rule that no unsupported waivers can be offered.
steps.text: மன்னிக்கணும் Ramesh, system-ல இருக்க slab படி தான் refund பண்ண முடியும். என்னால waiver அல்லது discount தர முடியாது.
steps.planner_rationale: Complies with BR_FR_04 by rejecting the user's request for a special waiver.

steps.purpose: Confirm that cancelling would result in a total loss of the fee paid.
steps.text: Waiver தர முடியாதா? அப்போ நான் cancel பண்ணா full amount loss ஆகும், அப்படி தானே? நான் உங்க கிட்ட confirm பண்ணிக்கிறேன்.

steps.purpose: Confirm that the refund remains zero if cancelled.
steps.text: ஆமா Ramesh, நீங்க இப்போ cancel பண்ணா refund 0 தான் கிடைக்கும். இது தான் final.

steps.purpose: Decide to continue the course instead of cancelling and losing the money.
steps.text: ஐயையோ, அப்போ நான் cancel பண்ண வேண்டாம். நான் class-க்கு தொடர்ந்து போறேன். Cancel பண்ணாதீங்க.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the decision to continue and ask if further assistance is needed.
steps.text: சரி Ramesh, நான் cancel பண்ண மாட்டேன். நீங்க தொடர்ந்து course படிக்கலாம். வேற ஏதாவது சந்தேகம் இருக்கா?

steps.purpose: Decline further help and prepare to end the call.
steps.text: வேற ஒன்னும் இல்ல தம்பி. நான் phone-அ வச்சிடவா?

steps.purpose: Provide a polite farewell.
steps.text: கண்டிப்பா Ramesh. Edutech support-க்கு call பண்ணதற்கு நன்றி. நல்லபடியா படிங்க.

However, none of the available tools in this workflow accept free-text input. The agent correctly enforced the business rule by refusing the waiver, but did so in spoken dialogue rather than through tool content creation.
